title: A source whose page moved is re-pointed by one command that writes the new row, supersedes the old one and re-keys its anchor and doc2query rows
goal: kbid.py (or factdiff.py) re-points a moved source in one command: a new _sources.csv row for the new url with the old row's licence, reuse and publisher, superseded_by on the old row, the citing facts' tags moved to the new id, and their anchor and doc2query rows re-keyed, so check and doc2query stale stay clean; found 2026-11-09 when two refresh runs re-pointed 20 moved sources by hand with scratch scripts for 60 anchor and 15 doc2query rows, and kbid.py add refused hosts with no registry licence record
